name: Imp
art_prompt: a small mischievous red imp devil with two short curved black horns on its head, bat-like pointed ears, a long thin pointed tail, glowing yellow eyes, a wicked grin with tiny fangs, a scrap of dark loincloth, holding a small black iron pitchfork upright in one hand, two arms and two legs, standing and facing the viewer
motion: scurrying in place with quick little steps, gripping its pitchfork in the same hand the whole time
gait: scurrying in place on the spot with quick little steps, gripping the same small black iron pitchfork upright in one fist the whole time, the pitchfork keeps its exact shape and never changes hands
anim_negative: extra horns, a third horn, extra arms, a third arm, extra hands, two pitchforks, extra fingers, extra legs, extra tails
dead_hint: lying flat on its back on the ground, dead: eyes shut tight, tongue hanging out, its body stretched out sideways across the picture with its head on the left and its feet on the right, arms flopped out limp, its pitchfork lying on the ground beside its open hand
back_hint: It still holds its small iron pitchfork upright in the same hand as in the front view, the tines visible beside its head.
doc: Stage 3's fodder: faster than a runt, twice its health, six to a pack, on top of the regular roster. The Brander calls rings of them.

IMP-0.note: the top-level strip, before the Level Editor's looks

IMP-A.note: Pass 122 recolour of the imp's own strip (IMP-0): a green imp for the Blood Moon's rose-red ground, painted strong (hue 145, blue-green shadows at 162, saturation 0.78 x its own, value lifted onto 0.44..0.98) so the stage's warm haze lands it at a light mint on screen (a pastel cut went grey-green there); the horns, eyes, teeth, loincloth and outline as they are (tools/recolour_strip.py --mode lift)
